name: widget-card
summary: The dashboard widget CHROME: a framed card with a grey header (title + a hover-revealed time badge + a hover-revealed kebab menu of Full Screen / Share / Edit / Clone / Remove), a body slot for any widget content (chart, gauge, heatmap, table…), the header as a drag handle, and a bottom-right resize grip. The card does not own its position — it emits card-dragstart / card-resizestart (composed, bubbling) so an obs-widget-grid parent can drive the layout, plus an action event for the kebab items.
selectHint: Use to wrap ONE widget on a dashboard grid — it is the frame around a chart/gauge/heatmap, not the chart itself. Inside a grid it becomes draggable (by its header) and resizable (bottom-right grip). Need a plain content card that is NOT a dashboard widget (a settings panel, a summary tile, a form card)? -> use a generic card, not obs-widget-card. Put the visualization in the default slot; don't reach for the chart element directly on the board.
whenToUse: A single widget on a dashboard/monitoring board that must be titled, draggable and resizable within an obs-widget-grid — the repeated chrome every dashboard tile shares.
insteadOf: a hand-rolled div with a grey title bar + absolute-positioned kebab
wiring drag/resize handlers onto a bare chart element
a generic card forced to look like a dashboard widget

variants.name: default
variants.what: Interactive widget chrome — header is a drag handle, a resize grip sits bottom-right; emits card-dragstart / card-resizestart for an obs-widget-grid parent.

variants.name: with-time
variants.what: Header carries a small time-range badge (time prop, e.g. '1h 12m') revealed on hover beside the kebab — the window the widget's data covers.

variants.name: static
variants.what: Chrome only (static prop): no drag handle, no resize grip, no drag/resize events — a plain framed card used outside a grid or in a locked/view dashboard.

sizes.name: grid-driven
sizes.note: The card fills its host box (:host { display:block; height:100% }); an obs-widget-grid cell (data-x/y/w/h) sets the footprint. Standalone, give the host an explicit width + height.

states.name: rest
states.what: Framed card with the grey header + title; the time badge, kebab and resize grip are hidden (opacity 0).

states.name: header-hover
states.what: Hovering (or focus-within) the card reveals the time badge + the kebab button in the header, and fades the resize grip in (opacity .6) at the bottom-right.

states.name: kebab-open
states.what: Clicking the kebab opens the options menu (Full Screen · Share · Edit · Clone · Remove); an outside click (across the shadow boundary) closes it. Choosing a row emits action and closes the menu.

states.name: dragging
states.what: Pointer-down on the header (non-static, left button) dispatches card-dragstart; the header shows a grab/grabbing cursor. The grid parent moves the card — the card itself does not reposition.

states.name: resizing
states.what: Pointer-down on the bottom-right grip (non-static, left button) dispatches card-resizestart (stops propagation so it is not read as a drag). The grid parent resizes the cell.

title.note: the widget title shown in the grey header (single line, ellipsised on overflow).

time.note: the hover-revealed time-range badge, e.g. '1h 12m' — the window the widget's data covers. Empty → no badge is rendered.

static.note: opt out of drag/resize (chrome only): hides the resize grip, drops the grab cursor, and suppresses card-dragstart / card-resizestart. Use outside a grid or on a locked board.

events.name: card-dragstart
events.note: pointer-down on the header (left button, non-static). Bubbles + composed so an obs-widget-grid ancestor can begin a drag. Not emitted when static.

events.name: card-resizestart
events.note: pointer-down on the bottom-right resize grip (left button, non-static). Stops propagation (so it is not read as a drag), bubbles + composed for the grid to begin a resize. Not emitted when static.

events.name: action
events.note: a kebab-menu item was chosen. Emitted as a Vue emit AND dispatched as a composed, bubbling CustomEvent(detail = key). The menu closes on selection.

slots.default: the widget BODY — the actual content the card frames (an obs-severity-heatmap, obs-gauge row, a chart div, a table…). The body area clips overflow and fills the remaining height under the header.

decisionFlow: Wrapping ONE widget on a dashboard/monitoring board that must be titled + draggable + resizable? -> obs-widget-card, with the visualization in the default slot.

Placing many widgets on a board and want drag-to-move / drag-to-resize? -> put each obs-widget-card inside an obs-widget-grid (it consumes card-dragstart / card-resizestart). The card alone does not move itself.
A framed card that is NOT a dashboard widget (settings panel, summary/KPI tile, a form section card)? -> use a generic card, NOT obs-widget-card.
On a locked / read-only / standalone board where widgets must not move or resize? -> obs-widget-card with static (chrome only, no drag/resize).
Need the chart/gauge/heatmap itself? -> that is a separate element (obs-gauge, obs-severity-heatmap, a chart) placed INSIDE the card's body slot — obs-widget-card never renders data, only the chrome.

default.useWhen: a widget sits on an obs-widget-grid dashboard and needs the shared chrome — title header, hover kebab, drag handle, resize grip
default.dontUse: for a non-dashboard card, or when you need the actual chart (that goes in the slot)
default.example: the Monitor Availability gauge widget on the Alert-Summary dashboard
default.asSeenIn: the Alert-Summary dashboard board (Infrastructure Heatmap, Monitor Availability, Alert Count, Top Network/Server Monitors, chart gallery)

with-time.useWhen: the widget's data covers a specific window worth surfacing on hover
with-time.dontUse: the window is global to the whole board and already shown in the page header/timeline
with-time.asSeenIn: every widget on the Alert-Summary board carries time="1h 12m"

static.useWhen: the card is standalone (no grid) or the board is locked / view-only — you want the frame but not drag/resize
static.dontUse: on a live editable dashboard where users arrange widgets
static.asSeenIn: standalone documentation / preview cards outside a grid

do: Put the visualization (chart/gauge/heatmap/table) in the default slot; the card is chrome, not content.
Give the card a size — inside a grid via the cell (data-x/y/w/h); standalone via an explicit host width + height — or the body has nothing to fill.
Use obs-widget-card inside an obs-widget-grid so card-dragstart / card-resizestart actually drive the layout.
Set time to the window the widget's data covers (e.g. '1h 12m') so the hover badge is meaningful.
Use static on locked / view-only boards or standalone cards to hide the drag/resize affordances.
Let the header, badge, kebab and grip inherit theme tokens — don't hardcode the grey header or menu colours.
dont: Don't use obs-widget-card as a generic content card — reach for a plain card for non-dashboard surfaces.
Don't wire your own drag/resize handlers onto the card — emit consumers (obs-widget-grid) own that; the card only signals start.
Don't render the card with no explicit size and expect the body to show — it needs a footprint.
Don't stuff multiple unrelated widgets into one card — one visualization per card.
Don't rely on the kebab/time being visible at rest — they are hover-revealed by design; don't put load-bearing controls only there.

a11y.summary: The kebab button has aria-label="Widget options"; the resize grip is aria-hidden decoration. Header and badge are text. The menu closes on any outside click across the shadow boundary.
issues: The time badge and kebab are revealed only on hover / focus-within — keyboard users reach them via focus, but a purely hover reveal is weak discoverability; don't place a widget's ONLY action in the kebab.

The kebab menu rows are <a> elements with no href, driven by click — so they are not keyboard-focusable and lack role="menu"/menuitem semantics or a roving tabindex, meaning the menu cannot be operated by keyboard and screen-reader menu navigation is limited.
Drag (header) and resize (grip) are pointer-only (pointerdown, left button) — there is no keyboard affordance to move or resize a widget; arrangement must not be the only path to a task.
a11y.notes: The card is chrome; the slotted widget owns its own data-accessibility (labels, table semantics, chart alt text). Provide a meaningful title so the widget is identifiable. Prefer surfacing critical actions outside the hover-only kebab when they must be reachable.

knownIssues: Drag and resize are pointer-only (pointerdown, left button) with no keyboard equivalent — a keyboard user cannot rearrange the board.
The kebab menu is a plain list of <a> rows (no href) without role="menu"/menuitem, roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation — mouse-operable only.

Position/size are NOT owned by the card — with no obs-widget-grid ancestor listening, card-dragstart / card-resizestart go nowhere and the card stays put (by design; use static to hide the affordances).

The kebab menu is absolutely positioned inside the card (top:32px right:6px, z-index 40) — on a very short card or near the grid edge it can be clipped by an overflow:hidden ancestor rather than escaping to a layer/portal.
The time badge + kebab are hover / focus-within revealed (opacity 0 at rest) — weak discoverability; don't route a widget's only action through the kebab.
changelog: 2026-09-07 — Added obs-widget-card: dashboard widget chrome — grey header with title + time badge + hover kebab (Full Screen/Share/Edit/Clone/Remove), body slot, drag handle + resize grip; emits card-dragstart/card-resizestart for obs-widget-grid. Header padding 5px. Used across the Alert-Summary dashboard.
